name: fable-advisor
description: Run your session on Fable 5.1 as a full-time architect: it writes specs and verdicts and picks a reasoning effort per task, GPT-5.6 Luna (via Codex) does the routine typing, GPT-5.6 Sol takes the high-complexity one-offs — and Fable 5.1 reviews every deliverable before it ships. Also ships the astra-operator browser/computer-use lane (GPT-6 Astra via Codex with headless Playwright Chrome) and its computer-use skill, the read-only data-investigator lane (Claude Sonnet) for query runs that keep raw data out of the architect context, and the astra-advisor cross-vendor reviewer (GPT-6 Astra via Codex, read-only).
